definitions.explanation: The process of seasoning ingredients before the main cooking process, typically to enhance flavor absorption and remove odors.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}に{下味|したあじ}を{付|つ}けてから{焼|や}く。
examples.english: Season the meat beforehand, then grill it.

examples.japanese: {下味|したあじ}には{塩|しお}と{胡椒|こしょう}を{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I used salt and pepper for the preliminary seasoning.

examples.japanese: {鶏肉|とりにく}を{下味|したあじ}に{漬|つ}けて{一晩|ひとばん}{置|お}く。
examples.english: Marinate the chicken in the seasoning and leave it overnight.

notes:
FORMATION: {下|した} (under/preliminary) + {味|あじ} (taste/flavor).

COOKING CONTEXT: A fundamental Japanese cooking technique used to prepare ingredients before the main cooking process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{下味|したあじ}を{付|つ}ける (apply preliminary seasoning)
・{下味|したあじ}に{漬|つ}ける (marinate in seasoning)
・{下味|したあじ}を{染|し}み{込|こ}ませる (let the seasoning soak in)

TYPICAL SEASONINGS:
・{塩|しお} (salt)
・{胡椒|こしょう} (pepper)
・{醤油|しょうゆ} (soy sauce)
・{酒|さけ} (sake)
・{生姜|しょうが} (ginger) - for removing odors
